image_description: A pastel plaid baby bib lying flat on a dark brown textured carpet. The bib features a pink, green, and white checkered pattern with a rounded bottom edge and a curved top neck opening trimmed in pink piping. White elastic or string ties extend from the top corners.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is correctly classified as a bib and not a similar textile item like a placemat or napkin.
To verify the edges of the bib are sharp and continuous, checking for melting into the carpet background or frayed/undefined boundaries.
To assess the realism of the fabric texture and the plaid pattern alignment, ensuring no warping or unnatural repetitions.

Consistency of the plaid pattern geometry
Realism of the fabric drape and folds
Structural integrity of the neck ties
